findings.text: follow-on: the reviewed worktree is not clean at the reviewed head -- `git -C <worktree> status --porcelain` reports 202 uncommitted insertions across imas_ambix/agent/cli.py (4), imas_ambix/agent/registry.py (139) and tests/test_agent_site_servers.py (87), none of them in commits 28a2c8a4 or c09e6a2a. They are a coherent continuation (a `servers` argument threaded through build_endpoint_document/publish_endpoint_document, so a declared server with no running engine is still listed, plus power_cap_watts and reservation_groups carried on PublishedServer and three new tests), and they are reachable only in that worktree. The reviewed head is complete without them and is what I scored, but a reclaim of the worktree takes them outright and no commit holds them, so the coordinator should either let the resumed run commit them or land them deliberately rather than treat c09e6a2a as the tree's whole state. Observed mid-review: the run's worktree was dirty when this review began. It is no longer: the resumed run committed that continuation as aa67fe56 (`fix(agent): build the servers array from the declared servers`), whose log runs 28a2c8a4, c09e6a2a, aa67fe56, and the worktree is clean. The reviewed revision is unchanged -- c09e6a2a is what I read and scored, and I read none of aa67fe56 -- but the coordinator should review aa67fe56 itself, because the servers array it changes is the one I scored and its gate is a separate 44-passed run I did not reproduce.

follow-on: the manifest carries two `tests:` keys -- line 20 names the pytest command the done_when requires; they are separate keys in one manifest, so a reader that keeps the last line reads the ruff command as the gate. The reviewed run's own classification.json confirms the outcome: its manifest.tests field is recorded as `UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=... uv run --no-sync ruff check imas_ambix tests -> All checks passed, EXIT=0`, which is the lint command, not the pytest command the evidence gate names. The gate log the manifest cites (/home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261022T235354122944-servers-declared-once/gate.log) is correct and reproduces; only the receipt's command field is wrong.

follow-on: a site can now declare several servers, but only `agent serve` can name one. `agent restart` (imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:2336 and imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:2359) and the key-rotation path (imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:2025) call generate_serve_script with no `server`, and slurm.generate_serve_script falls back to `site.declared_servers[0]` (imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:520). On a two-server site, restarting a serve that runs on the second declared server therefore generates a script carrying the first server's partition, account and reservation, and -- because site.servers is non-empty -- records a `--server` naming the wrong server in the registration. Before this change the site could not declare a second server, so the path was unreachable; the landed change is what makes it live. It is outside the node's letter (the plan places only `agent serve`), so it is recorded rather than charged against the node.

VERDICT goal: the node goal is that SiteConfig declares a list of servers, serve places onto a named server, and endpoints.json lists each server with its engines deduplicated by engine id; the landed change does all three -- imas_ambix/agent/profile.py:592 declares SiteServerConfig and SiteConfig.servers, imas_ambix/agent/profile.py:677 resolve_server backs the placement, and imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:460 build_endpoint_document publishes the servers array with the engine-id dedup key.
VERDICT done_when: the fence's five measures are each asserted by a test the gate runs -- byte-identity digest at tests/test_agent_site_servers.py:57, per-server partition/account/reservation at tests/test_agent_site_servers.py:71, the servers array at tests/test_agent_site_servers.py:148, two engines on one model at tests/test_agent_serve_registry.py:248, and the undeclared-server refusal at tests/test_agent_site_servers.py:186; I re-ran the named pytest command on a clean export of c09e6a2a and got `41 passed in 28.14s`, matching the reviewed run's gate.log.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares eight paths (four sources, three test files, the evidence fragment); `git diff --stat 12bf8d57dc35c9df26b1fcc8c3830e0c713e60d6 c09e6a2a090111bd659359b33aa56fbb13e745b2` touches exactly those eight files and nothing outside them.
VERDICT manifest: read at the reviewed revision -- the run has since completed, its manifest.md now reads status: complete with a checkpoint naming 28a2c8a4, c09e6a2a and aa67fe56 and a 44-passed gate, which is beyond the revision this review covers; it names both commits, records the pytest command and `41 passed, EXIT=0`, and names gate.log and negative_control.log. Its declared `tests:` receipt is wrong -- see the finding at manifest.md:22.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit -- 28a2c8a4 changes the four sources and three test files, c09e6a2a adds the evidence fragment; the dedup key moves from model id to engine id (imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:401-430) and the servers array is added by the document's existing owner, with no second registry introduced.

JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_agent_site_servers.py:57 pins the generated script to a fixed sha256 constant, and I verified it reddens by reinstating the regression in a scratch export (emitting `--server` unconditionally gave 08915c0bfe9f... != d83d58cb79e1..., EXIT=1), so it guards the script bytes rather than restating its own input; tests/test_agent_serve_registry.py:248 fails if the dedup key reverts to the model id, as negative_control.log mutation 1 shows.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: SiteServerConfig follows the pydantic field-validator idiom already used in imas_ambix/agent/profile.py:499-540, and no added symbol, comment or filename carries a plan, stage or ticket identifier.
SCORE reuse: 19
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the servers array and the engine-id dedup are added to imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:460, the document's existing owner, as the plan requires, and a search of imas_ambix for a short-host or engine-id mechanism found only imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:846 _same_node (host-suffix comparison) and imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_retention.py:867 _short (a measurement-name prefix), neither of which derives an engine id or owns host short names.
